title_candidates: Claude Tag brings shared AI agents into Slack
summary: Anthropic launched Claude Tag in beta for Claude Enterprise and Team customers, starting in Slack with channel-scoped memory, tools, logs, and spend limits.

primary_source.title: Introducing Claude Tag
primary_source.author: Anthropic
key_facts: Anthropic introduced Claude Tag as a beta for Claude Enterprise and Team customers.
Claude Tag starts in Slack, where users can tag @Claude in a channel and delegate tasks.
Admins can scope Claude's channel access, connected tools, memories, spend limits, and activity logs.
Anthropic says Claude Tag replaces the existing Claude in Slack app and offers a migration path for administrators.

steps.instruction: Pick one low-risk Slack channel where Claude can read context without seeing sensitive private data.
List the tools Claude should and should not access for that channel.
Set a spend limit and require logs before enabling Claude Tag for the broader team.
Test Claude in a private channel with one harmless task, such as summarizing a project thread.
Only expand access after someone reviews the output, the tool calls, and the channel scope.
